items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Oh, Russell Smith? [INTERVIEWEE] Russell Smith. So when -- so he married Russell's wife, see? So then Russell had taught her to play trumpet...

ctx.x: Russell Smith. So when -- so he married Russell's wife, see? So then Russell had taught her to play trumpet, so she was a little trumpet player. Said, "I hated that bitch." Said, "She taken me downstairs every morning and put that -- you know. And I'm staying in her house," said, "I had to play my little banjo."
